Name: Smart Gates
Author: Thielquis
Description:
[b][size=6]Smart Gates[/size][/b]
Tired of opening gates by hand?
[b]Smart Gates[/b] is a lightweight, performance-optimized mod that automatically opens [b]only the gate directly in front of you[/b]—no more accidental side-triggering.

If you prefer the more established proximity-based solutions, you may want to check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/820]AutoGate[/url].

[b]Update 28.03.2026 :[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3109]Automatic Gates[/url] has now also moved to a “front-only” opening mode. If you want extra configuration options and don’t need to squeeze out every bit of performance, their mod is a great alternative.


[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Directional gate opening[/b] - only opens when you're facing and moving into the gate[/*]
[*][b]Auto-closes gates behind you[/b][/*]
[*][b]Lightweight [/b]- I optimized the calls and calculations done as much as possible, which should lead to improved performance over other solutions[/*]
[*](optional) configurable delay[/*]
[*](optional) configuration to ignore already opened gates [size=2](to make some gates permanently open)[/size][/*]
[/list]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] for your configuration needs! 

[img width=500,height=500]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44116/44116-1774371627-1323142430.gif[/img]
